checks.scope: Offline source and generated-data training, checkpoint selection and inference reload checks; not a real-data benchmark

train.scope: Configurable training on supplied fixed splits; default budget differs from named published reference protocols

reference-training.scope: Exact published fresh-training budgets on identically prepared splits; CPU reference; checkpoint selection uses validation only

external_evidence_limits: See BENCHMARKS.md and DATA.md. Passing contract checks does not certify historical accuracy, live providers, physical safety or business outcomes.
